items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I'm using Don Cherry, Eddie Blackwell and you.

ctx.x: group. Blue had Walter Davis, Jr., myself, Al Foster and Lucky had Victor Sproles (PHONETIC), another Chicago bassist, a friend of mine, and I think he had Bill English on drums and I forgot who his pianist was.

Well, anyway, we played the job. Right after that, Blue say, "Well, I'm going into Minton's --" Minton's was still open -- "for a week. Wilbur, you want to make it?" I said, "Sure." Well, before this happened, I get a call from Clifford Jordan. Clifford and a friend of his, Harvey Brown, had formed a record company called New Frontier Records. He called me up, say, "Wilbur, look, I got four dates for you. Four paying dates. You get paid the same day that you make the records." I said, "Yeah, that's it." He says,…
